messages.text: Suns group is trying for the sand courts by the pier Thursday at 6:15 if your shift lets you make it.
I get off at 5:30, so I can change fast and come straight there. Save me a spot if they start rotations.
Bring the brace too. Last time you said the old side felt weird after those dives.
Already in my bag with tape. I want the workout, just not another two-week couch sentence.
Baby your mama said you got off late. I saved you a plate if you can swing by after class.
Thank you Grandma. I might need to just sit in your kitchen for a minute too.
Come on then. I will tell your brother to bring you back so you don't have to drive sleepy.
That helps. I already texted Mama before I left work.
Baby, I found that paper from the clinic. Too many tiny words on it.
Keep it by the phone. I'll come by after class and put the times in big marker.
Bring your brother if he needs supper. I got beans on low.
I'll ask him. And we can do your reading before the food gets cold.
Baby, you made it home from that long floor yet?
Not inside yet. I parked by the river for a few songs first. Anderson .Paak is doing the heavy lifting tonight.
Sit a minute if you need to. And keep that little card your mama gave you somewhere you can find it.
It's in my console. I'm not tossing it. If I keep going in circles like this, I'll use it.
Your brother's school form came back with a missing health line. Can you look before I call them?
Send me the screenshot. If it's the yearly clearance part, I would rather match it with his clinic record than guess.
I knew you would say that. I can call Dr. Reed's office in the morning.
Good. Their nurse can tell us what is current, and I'll check the Duval County page after work too.
Your cousin's clerk receipt came through. I can cover the first $35 but he still needs a ride downtown Friday morning.
For your school packet, use your long-form certificate from Baptist downtown. I put yours, mine, and your dad's courthouse copies in the blue folder.
I get off at 6:30. If he can wait, I can take him and just sit quiet until they call his name.
Found it. The packet asks the extra family-origin page too, but it looks like I just check no and move on.
Did you put the A&P quiz time in your phone for this week?
Yeah, I put it in twice and blocked off 8-9 after dinner.
Thank you. And remember what I always told you when someone stops you on the road: slow voice, palms where they can see them, no arguing.
Right. And on the uniform form, skip the DD-214 upload. That part never applied to you.
I know, Mama. Phone stays on the dash and I ask before reaching for anything.
Good. That locked screen situation had you too upset last time.
Good, I was hoping I didn't have to chase another document tonight.
I know. I am checking Canvas before work now too.
You making those bowls again Sunday or was that a one time thing?
Depends what Publix has left. I still got rice, black beans, and half a bag of collards.
Save me one if you put chicken in it.
If I stretch the pack right, yeah. Bring a container when you come by.
Are you still coming to the 6:30 class? I saved your spot by the mirror.
Can you grab trash bags when you come in? I used the last one under the sink.
Yes, just changing out of scrubs. I need loud songs and steps after that shift.
Yeah. Bri just texted that 7 works if we still want smoothies after courts.
Good. Bring the gray sneakers, the floor was slippery last week.
Perfect. I’ll start rice first, then we can roll out once you change.
Bet. My shoes are by the door already, just remind me not to forget my water bottle.
Already in my bag. If Bri texts, tell her I can meet after for smoothies if my legs still work.
I saved the next episode for when you get back. Don't let me start it by myself lol
Walking out now. Heat up the pasta and I'll be there in 20.
Bet. Also your teal hoodie is still on the chair for Sunday if you want it washed.
Please throw it in with yours. I need it clean before kickoff.
That playlist from practice had you smiling hard lol. I found a live brass set from Frenchmen St if you want it.
You still got that tote from the downtown walk? I need something sturdy for towels after practice.
Did you see the 8-count clip I sent? Same creator who does the scrub-pocket setup videos.
Send it. I had the other tab open with a place that does late sets and gumbo, so now I'm distracted.
Yeah, the one Taniya packed with water and granola. It still has a folded sign board in it lol.
Yes, I saved it from my For You page. I want to try the first part before volleyball if my legs aren't done.
Of course you found food with the music. Save me the good links for smoothie talk tomorrow.
Keep the board, bring the tote. Also I saw the city meeting clip about bus routes near the clinics. Made me think of what you were saying after shift.
Also your story from the court got more replies than my whole feed today.
Exactly. Folks miss appointments because the ride takes forever, then get blamed like they did not try.
Deal. I bookmarked one with a tiny stage, red beans, and those balcony pics.
Lol I answer those DMs way faster than any other app. I kept the tired-after-work rant off there though.
Baby I found that little cuff in the kitchen drawer. It still squeezes too tight.
Bring it Sunday and I'll write the numbers down before dinner. I want to compare it with the pharmacy machine too.
You always checking behind everybody now. Your school is making you bossy in a helpful way.
That night we all got scared taught me to pay attention. I need the practice anyway for the Saturday table idea.
Baby, Sister Elaine said the church tables need two more people Saturday morning.
Baby, are you still coming by after class Sunday? I found those old programs from the choir anniversary and the park celebration.
I can do 9 to 12 if they still need help. I already know how to run the cuff station and write down numbers.
Yes ma'am. Bring them out and I'll scan them before dinner. I want the one with Auntie Renee's solo too.
Good. A lot of folks came last time after choir practice, so wear your comfortable shoes.
Your cousin said the Riverside painter lady wants copies for her table this year.
I’ll bring extra pens and ask Mom if she has more intake sheets from the office.
I can drop them with Ms. Laverne after morning service if Mama gives me a ride.
Ma said you still got that old blue folder from after graduation?
Yeah, it has my final transcript, the state registry printout, and those two wallet cards from the skills weekend.
Can I look at it Sunday? Trying to see how you did work plus school without being stuck somewhere all day.
Bring it up after dinner. The trick was the short program first, then two night classes, not jumping straight into full-time hours.
Baby, if you stop by Sunday, bring that small bag of cornmeal from Winn-Dixie.
I can. You want the yellow bag or the one with the blue label?
Blue label. Your uncle said he is washing the greens this time, so we will see.
Lol I already know I need to come early before the good pieces disappear.
Bri said her cousin is having people over after the game. You going?
Maybe for a little bit. I'm driving myself, so I'm keeping it to one cup and heading out before everybody moves to the back porch.
Lol you always got an exit plan.
Because I still have scrubs to wash and I don't need my hair smelling like outside when I work at 6.
Portal finally stopped spinning. March rent posted and JEA looks higher than last month.
I saw it. I can send mine tonight after I move money from checking.
Cool. Xfinity autopay hits on the 9th, so I will cover it then and you can send your side after clinical.
Deal. Also the renewal screen still has both names grayed out, so I guess edits wait until they email us.
Did you eat before class? You sounded worn out on the phone.
I did. I just kept opening the tuition page and the assignment page last night, then my alarm came too fast.
One check each tonight, then put the phone in the kitchen. Also, that clinic visit was just a regular check-in, right?
Yeah, routine visit. No new plan or referral. I just need to stop doing midnight math in my head.
Beach courts at 2 still work? I can swing by Smoothie King after.
Yep. I might be 10 late because I promised Ms. Dana I’d help her check her address against the Duval site first.
You and those county pages lol. Is this for the tiny races again?
Yeah, people know the big November line but get stuck on judges and board seats. I made a short list based on clinic prices, school money, and who talks like they’ve worked a real shift.
Smoothies after beach courts? Marcus said bring whoever, he saved extra chairs.
I can come for one hour, then I need to finish the care plan and sleep before my 6:30 shift.
If we do smoothies after practice, are you still stopping by that wall on Mayport Rd?
Yeah, the colors hit better before sunset. Then I can swing by the water for a few frames if traffic is light.
Got it. Just you then? I am ordering ahead.
Yep, just me. Mango spinach, no protein powder.
You and that little camera stay busy. I can drive if your hands are full with the tripod bag.
Deal. If we leave right after, I can still get home before Taniya starts dinner.
You still coming to beach courts after your shift or are you trapped by Town Center?
Leaving early because JTB is already crawling. I can grab smoothies first since everything is right by my side.
That area spoils you until the cars stop moving lol.
For real. I know every back way from Beach to Kernan at this point.
Smoothie after beach courts or you heading straight home?
Straight home tonight. I made rice bowls before I left, so I’m being good and eating that.
Lol okay. Still stopping at Town Center for those black leggings?
Leaving them in the cart for now. Tire place got me this morning.
Baby, if you come by tomorrow, can you look at this paper from the clinic? It got too many little lines on it.
Yes ma'am. I'm going to Mama's after my shift, then I can come sit with you before dinner.
Your auntie said she got greens going too, so don't eat before you get here.
Tell her save me a corner piece of cornbread. I'll bring the cuff batteries too.
Baby did that card from your job come in the mail yet? I found my old one behind the coupons.
Mine came yesterday. I put it in the folder with my stubs before I lose it.
Good. Keep all that together. And do not spend all that Friday money before rent.
I already moved rent first. Left myself grocery money and gas, then the rest stays put till the next Friday hit.
Baby, did you get home? I know Saturdays there keep you moving.
Just pulled in. Had to stay after because the hallway computer froze while I was entering the last room notes.
Put that blue outfit straight in the wash and sit down a minute.
Already doing it. Today was showers, lunch help, two transfers, and then cleaning down the cart before I left.
Baby you made it home from that early floor today?
Yes ma'am, clocked out after report and stopped for gas. My feet are loud today.
Come by tomorrow after church if you are not on the board again.
Tomorrow is open unless they beg for coverage. This week landed at 35.5 before any begging.
Did you ever call Dr. Nguyen's office back? You still use that same place on University, right?
Yeah same place. They said I haven't been in there since last year so they want the longer packet.
Fill it out before you go. If the daily stuff section is empty, still write something so they don't send it back.
I put vitamins sometimes and Tylenol if needed. The big history pages are mostly blanks again.
Publix after work? I can cook the chicken if you grab veggies and rice.
Yes, but I need to keep it around $55. I already had gas and Geico hit this week.
Send me the cart before checkout and I’ll split the stuff we both eat.
Bet. I’m checking VyStar in the aisle so I don’t mess up the rest of the week.
I just got in. Sink is doing that thing again lol. You want me to run the dishwasher before I crash?
Please. I came in and sat on the bed for like 40 minutes with one shoe still on.
Got it. Also your notebook is still on the kitchen chair from yesterday.
I know. I keep walking past it. I'll grab it after I move the cups off my nightstand.
Do I need to bring anything tonight or just show up after practice?
Just come hungry. I did a pan with greens and quinoa, and another one with rice for whoever wants more.
Bet. Taniya said you bought half the produce aisle.
Only because y'all keep saying one scoop then getting seconds.
Baby did you see Sister Darlene by the side door? She had that little notebook out.
Yes ma'am, I gave her my $20 before we left. She checked my name off.
Good. Don't let them have to call you twice, you know they will.
I know. I kept my grocery receipt too, still paid regular card and coupons like usual.
Auntie Renee put the dinner headcount under my tagged post. Can you tap going so Ms. Harris stops calling me?
Doing it now. I saw Pastor's note too, y'all moved the youth program to 3?
Yes, after the morning service. And don't forget your folder if you're staying for the music meeting.
Got it. I'll change shoes at your house first and ride over with you.
You still got that folder from the Arlington place? Mom said it might have my old shot paper too.
Yeah, the one from when we were both at Mom's. I found your report card behind all her patient-window sticky notes.
Lol she kept everything. Dad wrote his shop number on the back of mine, I remember calling him from that kitchen phone.
I saw that. Same handwriting on the oil-change receipt he left in the envelope.
Can I crash on your couch after Sunday dinner if Ma takes my ride?
That couch is free Sunday night. I just have to ask Taniya before I promise it.
Bet. I will bring my charger and be out before your early shift.
Use the visitor spot by building C if you drive. My parking pass is already on my car.
Send me that pasta thing you made. Mom said you got it from a video with no measurements again.
It was a 42-second clip, I had to pause it like five times. I'll DM you the saved post and my notes.
Put it on your story so I can find it later.
Nah, I'm only posting the plate pic. If people ask, I'll send it one by one.
Did the office ever fix that paper with your name and Taniya's name? I can look over it Sunday if you want.
They said the June date is right, just the renewal offer is not ready yet.
Okay. Keep every receipt for the rent, lights, and internet so nobody has to guess later.
I have screenshots in the apartment folder. Taniya keeps the same folder too.
Still coming to volleyball? Beach courts are busy but we can grab smoothies first.
I might be late. I got waved over by the bridge and did the whole window-down, hands-on-wheel thing until they let me go.
Smoothies after your shift or are you doing couch time with Taniya again?
Take your time. You good?
Couch time tonight. We left off right when the detective found the receipt.
Yeah. Just tired. Same reason I double-check who wrote a flyer before I share it, even when it is from a clinic or city office.
Ok then Sunday? I can come by before the 1 pm thing if y'all have room.
Come through. Taniya already said she's making dip before the teal towels go on the couch.
You still down for Friday night? I found a place with a DJ and space to actually move.
Please. My brain has been stuck on school and work all day.
Then we are doing two songs minimum before you start saying you're tired.
Deal, but Saturday morning serves are going to be ugly if you keep me out late.
Baby I saw your mama put the funeral meal list on that blue app. Tell her I can bring greens.
I'll comment it for you. They also posted that the praise team needs everybody there early Saturday.
Good. And practice that second verse, the altos got soft last time.
Baby, that paper from church clinic confused me. They said bring my card but I don't know which one.
Bring the little folded record and your medication list. I'll look at it with you after class.
Somebody at Bible study said I should wait and see what everybody else does.
Let's call your doctor's nurse first. She knows your blood pressure history better than anybody in that room.
Baby, when you do that family tree sheet, put Jacksonville for your mama and Macon for your daddy. My side came up from Georgia before I was a girl.
Thank you. I was trying to remember which town to write for everybody.
And put Mount Zion for where we kept records back then. Your great-granddaddy's name is still in that church book.
I'm adding that note. It makes the sheet feel less random.
You been short with everybody today. Did you eat before work?
Not really. My uniform pile is still on the chair and I have to leave in 20.
Take crackers at least. One small thing first, then the rest when you get home.
Okay. Taniya has class late too, so the trash might have to wait until after my shift.
Bring your tax folder Sunday. I can look over the forms before dinner.
Thank you. It should be quick: W-2, school form, rent receipt, and that one line stays 1 like last year.
Good. Also do not let your auntie talk you into hosting extra people after your shift.
I am going straight home after dinner. Monday exam review is already staring at me.
You still coming with us for wings before the game?
I’m gonna watch from home. I grabbed chicken from Mom’s freezer and I work 7 to 3 tomorrow now.
Dang another shift?
Yeah, and I’m skipping the new shoes I had saved in my cart. Send me the score though.
Ma said you might miss dinner Saturday. You got class or Riverside?
Riverside asked me to cover 7-3 because two people scratched off. I said only if they keep me off Monday.
They always call you when the hallway gets thin.
That's why those breakroom cards caught my eye. More hands, better checks, and walking out without feeling unsafe would change a lot.
Ma said you sent me another link. What am I supposed to look at?
Just the county lookup. Make sure your address is right before the deadline. Takes two minutes.
You already know I only pay attention when the White House stuff is on TV.
That part matters, but the local names decide bus stops, school board stuff, and who gets heard downtown. Start with the ones I starred in blue.
Ma said you were quiet after work. You straight?
Long shift. One resident kept asking if his son made it home from the traffic stop. I was doing vitals and trying not to show my face.
That would mess with me too.
It is all connected. People come in tense, bills stacked, rent up, no steady ride, and then we expect their numbers to look perfect.
You still coming Sunday? Ma said you were staring at that laptop like it owed you money.
Lol I am coming. I was trying to finish the care plan before midnight and also see what my card balance did after gas.
Close it after you submit. You always try to do three extra things.
I know. I put a 10:30 alarm to shut it down because 2 AM me makes bad choices.
Zumba at 6:30 or are you doing your laptop block first?
Laptop first. My phone goes off at 6:05 for the micro quiz thing.
Okay I will not talk through it lol. Proud of the new system.
Please don’t let me sit down for shows until I hit submit.
You still going to the beach courts after clinical prep tomorrow or are we doing Zumba instead?
Beach courts if Bri confirms. I need something that makes me sweat after being inside all day.
Okay but ice that ankle when you get home. You always act fine then limp to the kitchen.
Fair. I packed the wrap, and I am skipping the dramatic saves if the sand is loose.
Do y’all still have plain envelopes at your front desk? I need some for those follow-up cards from Saturday.
I can grab a small stack. Don’t take home anyone’s full paperwork, just the cards Sister Elaine cleared.
Yes ma’am. I only wrote first name, phone, and whether they wanted the clinic call.
Good. Put them in the folder before your shift so they don’t get lost in your car.
When you fill that form, make sure the date line matches your old card. 09/18/2004.
Got it. It feels weird typing that next to all this grown-up apartment paperwork.
You are grown, baby. Check the 32246 address twice before you submit it.
I will. The portal keeps auto-filling my old side of town, so I am fixing it before class.
Did the school payment go through or is it still sitting there?
It posted. I’m at $1,312 for March before the next grocery run and my phone.
Write the numbers down somewhere too, not just in the app.
I know. I keep looking at VyStar and thinking I’ll remember, then I don’t.
You still dropping me by Ma's before you go?
Yeah but be outside. I have the green top on and cannot be late for 7.
Got you. Why your bag so packed?
Gloves, spare socks, little notebook, and my badge. Yesterday I forgot to write down two dinner percentages before logging them.
Ma said you took that boardwalk pic this morning before class. How did you even have time?
Left early, parked off Fort Caroline, did one short stretch, then got back on Merrill before it got packed.
Send me the one with the trees over the water. I need a new lock screen.
I’ll send the sharper one after lab. The first one has my thumb in the corner.
Ma said you sounded worn out. You straight?
I'm okay. Taniya let me vent while we chopped onions, so I'm calmer now.
Good. Also can you Cash App me 12 till Friday? I can bring Grandma's meds by your place first.
Sent. Drop them with Taniya if I'm still at the facility.
Ma said you got a doctor thing Monday. You need me to move your car or anything?
I'm good, it's just a morning visit before class. I found my card but not much else to bring.
They always ask a million questions on those papers.
Exactly. I'm leaving most of those little boxes alone unless something changed.
Ma said you know the song from that June stage thing. She wants us to help the little kids with the words.
I remember the hook because Grandma had us practicing it in the kitchen every year.
Do I have to wear the shirt from the Urban League booth again?
Probably. Just don't wrinkle it before we take the group picture with the nurses.
Did the clinic form go through? It kept asking for upload boxes on mine last semester.
Yeah. For the letter boxes I just marked none and uploaded my paystubs.
Ok good. Also rent app says our side is due Monday, same split?
Same split. I moved a little from rainy-day money already, just waiting on the shop number.
Beach nets at 10 still? I can grab the mango smoothies after.
Yes, but I may be 10 min late. Dropping the extra gloves and wipes at Ms. Anita's table first.
You always make your rounds before you let yourself have fun lol.
I still want my sets in. Save me a spot and don't let Drea take my side.
Before smoothies, can you ask your dad if he still knows how to get that squeal out of my brakes?
I can ask. He used to hear stuff like that before anybody else did, even when he was just stopping by after work.
Your people are useful lol. Didn't your mom used to know every code on those insurance papers too?
She still catches errors fast. Growing up, the kitchen table always had her folders on one side and my brother's school stuff on the other.
You left right before the patio got packed last night.
Yeah, once people started passing stuff around I was good. My one strawberry thing was enough.
Fair. You were still the only person up for smoothies after.
Smoothie and sleep saved me. I had no headache and my uniform didn't smell weird this morning.
If we do smoothies after practice, can I leave my beach bag at your place first?
Yeah. Text me when you get to the gate and I’ll buzz you up.
Cool, I won’t take up your whole hallway this time lol.
Hallway is clear now except me and Taniya’s laundry baskets.
You and Taniya still coming later or did y’all get stuck doing that kitchen reset?
We’re almost done. She took counters, I’m finishing dishes, then we’re heading out.
Okay I’ll hold off ordering my smoothie. Text me when you’re pulling up.
Deal. If we’re late it’s because Taniya made me change out of my work slides first.
I put Grandma's appointment printout on the counter. The salt note is circled and her morning pill changed.
Thank you. After work I'm making her a simple chart with check boxes so she doesn't have to remember all of it.
That would help. Also ask your advisor if your service hours can count at the church fair.
I will. If they approve it, I can do cuff checks there and have first-semester people shadow me.
Tomorrow after church still good? Your brother keeps asking if you bringing that banana pudding.
Yes, I'm off at 12:30 if they don't hold me late. I'll come straight there and make it before everybody eats.
Good. Grandma wants you to read over those appointment notes again while the cousins are still around.
I got her. I can sit with her before I head back to the apartment.
You sounded tight on the phone. Did you go straight home?
Took Beach Blvd the long way and let the J. Cole album run. I needed nobody asking me anything for a minute.
Okay. If that minute turns into all week, pull up the number I sent from your benefits folder.
I know. I saved it. I'm not against making a first call if I can't shake it.
Ma said don't come late tomorrow because last time you were mad the tray was picked over.
Because y'all left me bones and one corner piece. I'm clocking in early this time.
Grandma already told me to stay out the kitchen unless I'm cutting onions.
Good. Also tell her I got the pepper vinegar she asked for.
Baby bring your little cards when you come by, the clinic lady asked who showed me that counting and breathing practice.
I will. They expire in 2027 so I'm still good, and I can show you again after church.
You always had papers and classes after you walked that stage. I told your auntie you picked a sensible route.
It kept me moving. Short course, then campus nights, then I could work real shifts.
Baby did you ever make that shrimp and okra dish you showed me?
Not yet. I saved the recipe with the dark roux one too. I want to taste it made right first.
Mhm then ask somebody's auntie when you go. Restaurants are fine but aunties know.
That's what I'm saying. I wrote down the market and the old houses tour for the same day.
Can you still spot me for the shoes or nah?
I can do $35 now. I got $1,184 on the 6th and I'm trying to make it stretch until the 20th.
That helps. I forgot you move stuff right away.
Yeah rent and lights got first claim. Also saving my hours at work in case Mom needs me for Nana's appointment.
Baby did you send that paper for the church table Saturday?
I printed 20 copies. It has the clinic hours, tutoring sign-up, and the number for the rent help office.
Good. Put the senior ride number big. Some folks cannot read tiny letters.
I made it bold. Same folder from when Ms. Renee had us meet downtown, so I will bring that too.
Call the shop before class. If it's close to $400, don't drain yourself all at once.
I'm covering the first part from what I tucked away. If it runs over, the Visa can hold the rest till payday.
Can you grab one more Saturday at work?
I texted Keisha. Also I still have Darlene's $20 ready for Sunday, not touching that envelope.
You taking lunch to work or buying something?
Taking my container. Rice, beans, last chicken thigh, and the peppers from your fridge.
Good. Don't spend $14 over there again.
I know. I already wrote down collards and quinoa for after payday too.
Mama said you were taking cuz again Monday. That building make everybody act stiff.
Just trying to keep him from missing another time slot. Gas plus parking keeps adding up.
You always tell me the same thing too, like keep my hands out my hoodie pockets if lights pull behind me.
Because I need you home, not proving a point on the curb.
Did the hospital volunteer app finally accept your answers? Mine froze on that benefit-preference part.
Yeah, I left the DD-214 line empty and it let me submit after I uploaded my ID.
Good. Did you use your grandma's wording for the community background box?
I did. I kept it simple: Jacksonville, Georgia church records, and Sunday family stuff.
Suns chat moved Sunday to 10 because half the crew works nights. You in?
Yes, Sunday works before family dinner. I want reps but keep me away from the deep corner if my foot starts complaining.
Deal. Smoothies after if we survive the sun?
Definitely. I have been on my feet all week, so I am counting Sunday as my real movement for the weekend.
When you come Sunday, bring that blue accordion folder. I want the old school contacts separated from my clinic paperwork.
Okay. I saw mine and his tucked together, with Dad's number written in a different corner like always.
That's the one. Leave my claim notes rubber-banded, please, I may need those examples for a coworker.
Got it. I'll keep the school forms, your desk notes, and Dad's work slips in separate piles.
Mom said ask you about the campus health hold. They won't let me finish registration.
Upload the clinic record first. If the portal still blocks you, call student health and ask what line is missing.
Can I just use that TikTok chart somebody sent?
No. Use the school instructions or the county clinic page. Screenshots from random people are how forms get rejected.
I paused it at 32:18. Your work shoes by the door told me you had a day.
Thank you. I just need food, shower, then press play.
Also don't forget the grocery run tomorrow. If we wait until Sunday, the EverBank traffic will be annoying.
Tomorrow works. I want Sunday clear anyway.
You still going by your mom's Sunday? I'm trying to plan groceries before I buy too much.
Yeah, I'll probably bring leftovers back if they pack plates like usual.
Then I'm not thawing chicken. Save me the cabbage-looking greens if they have them.
Deal, but the crunchy corner pieces are not roommate property.
Baby did you find the paper for me? I don’t want to stand there guessing again.
Yes ma’am. I circled the people who backed the insulin cap, teacher raises, and the rent-help office. I’ll bring it after I check your pressure.
Thank you. I just want somebody who remembers regular folks after the cameras leave.
Same. I also added the early-site hours so we can avoid the long line.
After choir rehearsal, stop by the fellowship hall. Mrs. Carter needs the sign-up sheet for the June booth.
Okay. I can add the blood pressure table next to the art display if they still need spacing.
Good. And ask Deacon Miles who is telling the neighborhood history part this year.
I'll ask before I leave. Grandma will fuss if I spell anybody's name wrong.
Did the internet bill clear yet?
Yes, Taniya sent her half and I paid it before dinner.
Good. Keep the screenshot with your rent folder.
I saved it with the utilities. March folder is done.
I put extra rice and chicken in the blue container. Taniya can grab it when she leaves Zumba.
Please tell her thank you. Today had me quiet all the way home.
I figured. Call me after you eat, even if it's just five minutes.
I will. Ms. Renee texted me a little line earlier too, so I'm hanging in.
Ma said you working tonight but still coming by before?
Yeah. I told Auntie I would set up the ride sheet and make sure Grandma's numbers got copied right.
You want me to bring anything or just not disappear?
Bring yourself and tell Ma the truth if you need gas money. No acting cute then stressing later.
Why you got a whole map with cemetery stops on the kitchen table?
